name: Owari no Seraph: Unmei no Hajimari
original_name: 終わりのセラフ 運命の始まり
source:
In 2012, the world allegedly comes to an end at the hands of a "human-made" virus, ravaging the global populace and leaving only children under the age of thirteen untouched. It is at this time that vampires emerge from the recesses of the earth, likely followed by age-old horrors of the dark thought only to be myth. The vampires sweep the earth and claim it in a single violent stroke, subjugating the remnants of humanity and leading them beneath the surface to safety. This "protection" comes at the price of donating blood to their captors. At the age of twelve, Yuuichirou and his friend and fellow orphan Mikaela plotted to escape along with the children in Hyakuya Orphanage. However, this resulted in their deaths and Mikaela sacrifices himself in order for Yuuichirou to escape and be saved by members of the Moon Demon Company, an extermination unit of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army. Four years later, Yuuichiro dedicates his life to destroy vampires and seek revenge against them for murdering his "family".

[From Wikipedia]

In the "dramatic tactics battle" game, the player's decisions throughout the game will change the ending. Players level up their bonds with comrades on the battlefield by raising their "family level." When the "family level" rank goes up, players experience a "family event" scene. Characters will get special endings if players build trust with them during battle.

[From [url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/daily-briefs/2015-08-30/owari-no-seraph-ps-vita-game-ships-this-winter/.92265]Anime News Network[/url]]
translation:
2012年，世界据称因“人造”病毒而走向末日，病毒肆虐全球，只有13岁以下的儿童未受影响。正是在这个时候，吸血鬼从地球的深处出现，随后很可能出现了古老的黑暗恐怖，人们认为这只是神话。吸血鬼席卷了地球，并以一次猛烈的攻击占领了地球，征服了人类的残余，并将他们带到了地表以下的安全地带。这种“保护”是以向绑架者献血为代价的。十二岁时，雄一郎和他的朋友兼孤儿米凯拉密谋与百谷孤儿院的孩子们一起逃亡。然而，这导致了他们的死亡，米卡拉牺牲了自己，以便优一郎逃脱并被日本帝国恶魔军消灭部队月恶魔连的成员所救。四年后，佑一郎毕生致力于消灭吸血鬼，并为他们谋杀他的“家人”而报仇。

[来自维基百科]

在“戏剧性的战术战斗”游戏中，玩家在整个游戏过程中的决定将改变结局。玩家通过提升“家族等级”来提升与战场上战友的联系。当“家族等级”等级上升时，玩家会体验到“家族事件”场景。如果玩家在战斗中与角色建立信任，角色将会获得特殊的结局。
